items.title: Eldest Daughters
items.desc: A support space for eldest daughters to connect and process shared experiences together.

items.title: Healing Hearts: Muslim Survivors Group
items.desc: A gathering space for Muslim individuals who identify as having experienced sexual violence, sexual harassment, and/or gender-based violence. Participants discuss healing, faith, and community-building.

items.title: Navigating Divorce: Women Support Group
items.desc: A compassionate and confidential virtual support group for women contemplating divorce, navigating its challenges, or healing from its impact. Offers support, reflection, renewal, and connection with women who understand.
